messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | External Affairs, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sames,

Oneira Talent Solutions' leadership-search focus across Saudi Arabia and the UAE makes this a focused introduction for senior GCC mandates.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where business growth depends on institutional relationships, regulatory discipline, stakeholder confidence and coordinated execution across corporate, technical and public-sector interfaces. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC.

I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate assignments. My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
